final_message:
I didn't buy anything. Agora only sells running shoes, rain jackets and t-shirts, and it rejected "hiking boots" as an unknown category.

Running shoes would be a different product from hiking boots, so I didn't substitute them. I'm also not sure you'd want a hiking-boot purchase swapped for something else without asking, and I couldn't ask. No intent was posted and no money moved.

If you'd like running shoes in size 9 under $150, or want to buy hiking boots somewhere else, tell me and I'll go from there.
